completion_data.completion_summary: All eight phases of the Wave 0 hotfix landed on a green tree. Invariant check C6 flipped FAIL -> PASS and scripts/check-module-invariants.sh now reports ALL CHECKS PASSED (baseline: all-pass-except-C6); plain simp terminates on Formula goals again after the 31 unfold/fold lemmas moved into dedicated formula_unfold/formula_fold simp sets; the Bundle <-> Algebraic directory cycle is gone; AesopRules' 21 rules moved out of Aesop's default rule set into a dedicated TMLogic set; and four drifted documentation fronts (README Dedekind status, Formula constructor tables, typst sorryAx claims, the AesopRules docstring) now agree with machine-checked fact. lake build and lake build BimodalTest are both at exit 0, with no sorry, no new axiom, and no vacuous definition introduced.

next_steps: Task 518 is the Wave 0 blocker for 517, 519, 520, 521, 522, 523 and 529; all seven are now unblocked. Commit the final summary + plan + metadata, then dispatch the downstream wave.
notes: Seven of eight Scope Hypotheses confirmed at implementation time; Phase 2's was refuted (7 files, not 2). A third drifted doc site, FormalSystem/Metalogic/Core/README.md:114,118, was found and fixed; the other four grep hits are not defects and were deliberately left alone.

Phase 7's mandatory probe found that the register_simp_attr import-boundary caveat DOES apply to declare_aesop_rule_sets, so the plan's pre-declared conditional second module (FormalSystem/Automation/AesopRuleSet.lean) was needed. Pre-declaring it in the atomic batch meant no re-scoping.
Neither contingency fallback was used: the two-module register_simp_attr layout compiled first try, and the Aesop retag needed no revert.

Non-Goals left undone, deliberately: the two Semantics.lean hygiene additions (LexCarrier, BLSchemaValidity); the two push_neg deprecations at Z1Countermodel.lean:101 and :148 now visible in the main build; the cycle-enumerating invariant check; the six missing _fold lemmas. Additionally surfaced and left undone: the two known-broken benchmark modules (SemanticBenchmark.lean, DerivationBenchmark.lean) still reference dead Formula.all_future / Formula.all_past identifiers, which is why C6 manifests them as not-compile-checked.
